title: accept_authenticated_schc_packet ignores DIO admission counter floor
description:
File: rust/lichen-schc/src/link.rs

Python LinkLayer.accept_authenticated_schc_packet rejects ingress when logical_counter(epoch, seqnum) <= the DIO issuance admitted_counter (test_peer_policy_gates_unfragmented_ingress_and_egress, match 'predates'). AuthenticatedFragmentReceiver::receive_frame in this crate already rejects counter <= admission_floor.

accept_authenticated_schc_packet never compares the data frame counter to peer.authenticated_counter(). Link replay can still accept an in-window older seqnum that was not yet seen (DIO at N, delayed data at N-k). That packet is then decompressed under the newer peer SCHC policy.

Compute the frame counter the same way fragment.rs does ((epoch as u32) << 16) | seqnum and reject when counter <= peer.authenticated_counter() as InvalidPeerEvidence / invalid packet, matching Python.
acceptance_criteria: A replay-accepted SCHC data frame whose logical counter is less than or equal to the peer DIO authenticated_counter is rejected. A frame with a strictly greater counter still decompresses. Behavior matches Python predates-policy rejection and the fragment receiver admission floor. Test covers seqnum == floor and seqnum == floor+1 on the same admitted peer context.
close_reason: Reject unfragmented SCHC data when logical counter <= DIO authenticated_counter. Test covers seqnum == floor, in-window floor-1, and floor+1. cargo test -p lichen-schc --features std --test link_layer_integration 5 passed.
